results.name: Lufthansa Airbus A340-600
results.description:
The Airbus A340 is a long-range, wide-body passenger airliner that was developed and produced by Airbus.
Keeping the eight-abreast economy cross-section of the A300, the early A340-200/300 has a similar airframe to the A330-200/300. Differences include four 151 kN (34,000 lbf) CFM56s instead of two high-thrust turbofans to bypass ETOPS restrictions on trans-oceanic routes, and a three-leg main landing gear instead of two for a heavier 276 t (608,000 lb) Maximum Takeoff Weight (MTOW). Both airliners have fly-by-wire controls, which was first introduced on the A320, as well as a similar glass cockpit. The A340-500/600 are longer, have a larger wing, and are powered by 275 kN (62,000 lbf) Rolls-Royce Trent 500 for a heavier 380 t (840,000 lb) MTOW.

results.name: '91-93 Unnamed And Untamed Monster Truck
results.description:
Revived this documentation project after someone from the BeamNG forums wanted to import it into game.

This is version of truck that ran from late '90 or early '91 to '93. After that body was seen briefly at the top of tube chassis and this chassis was sold and become High Anxiety. At this point truck had nothing from original mud truck built at '84-.85. First body was destroyed in rollover crash in Fremont '88. At same time they replaced stock chassis with ladder one. '88 chassis was converted in '90 to monster truck and destroyed same year in Molella. This new chassis was built in 9 days and ran at the day of its completion. In addition to much stronger and heavier chassis, Unnamed also received suspension update, now boasting 5 shocks on every corner, pan hard- and sway bars on both rear and front axle.

![](https://img1.wsimg.com/isteam/ip/8e2d2d84-3f94-47bb-808a-1c299b231f80/uu1991-3.png/:/cr=t:0%25,l:0%25,w:100%25,h:100%25/rs=w:600,cg:true)

results.name: T-54 wot SD
results.description: t-54 wot sd модель в камуфляже Steppe старая модификация текстуры танка модель 2013 Т-54 - Предпоследний средний танк девятого уровня в ветке СССР. Дальность обзора в стоковом(базовом) состоянии 380 метров, дальность связи 600 метров. Танк является одним из самых лучших в игре. Высокая скорость, убойная сила, хорошая скорострельность, отличная маневренность. Все эти качества невольно заставляют уважать Т-54. Принят на вооружение Советской Армии в 1946 году, серийно выпускался, постоянно модернизируясь, с 1947 года. С 1958 года выпускалась его модификация под названием Т-55.
